summary: Citius Oncology filed an 8-K regarding a warrant inducement agreement with an existing warrant holder covering 12,777,778 shares. The holder agreed to exercise induced warrants at a reduced cash exercise price of $0.90 per share (down from $1.09) in exchange for new warrants to purchase up to 25,555,556 shares at $0.90, subject to stockholder approval. New warrants expire five years after approval or registration effectiveness. A 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation applies. This is a capital-raising warrant restructuring, not a special situation like a tender, going-private, M&A, or activist campaign.
